gaps: HiLux AN120/130: brakes, diffs, 1GD drain plug and U-bolts not found from a Toyota source (Tacoma cross-ref shown separately).
LC200: AU steel vs alloy wheel nuts, brakes, suspension and 1VD drain plug not confirmed (LC100 steel 209 / alloy 131 is a cross-reference only).
RAV4 / Celica / MR2: chassis torques not yet from a Toyota source (in image-only FSM pages).
Open conflicts: RAV4 2AZ drain plug 25 vs 40 N·m; LC200 caliper bolts pre/post 2015; 3UR-FE spark plug 18 vs 21 N·m; HiLux Toyota towbar M16 260 vs 310 N·m on the same sheet.
Resolved: 1ZZ-FE spark plug = 25 N·m (second Toyota manual); LC200 wheel stud M14x1.5 (parts listings).

Pass 4 could not find Toyota-labelled sources for: HiLux brakes/diffs/sump plug/U-bolts, LC200 suspension and 1VD drain plug, MR2 chassis, RAV4 chassis. Open conflicts: RAV4 drain plug 25 vs ~40 (leans 40), HiLux towbar M16 260 vs 310 (leans 260), RAV4 rear guide bolt 27 vs 34.
